related: PageContainer — `cover`, `icon`, headerScale="display" for an article title.
Image — an image that opens a preview.
tagline: A page's cover image (gh#1160): Notion's banner across the top, or note.com's eyecatch (~1.91:1, rounded) in the reading column. Put it in PageContainer `cover`. The focal point is positionY (object-position); while `repositioning` the image IS a vertical WAI-ARIA slider — drag or arrows / PageUp / PageDown / Home / End, Enter / Escape to finish.
usage: DO pass it as PageContainer `cover` with the page `icon` — the container places it and overlaps the icon.
DO wire a Reposition button in `actions` that sets `repositioning`, and persist positionY from onPositionChange.
